charms.name: Nazar boncuğu
charms.description: A glass eye bead hung to deflect the evil eye, the envious glance believed to bring misfortune. Found across Turkey, Greece and the wider Mediterranean, on doorways, cradles and dashboards alike.

charms.name: Hamsa
charms.description: An open right hand, often with an eye in the palm, carried as protection against harm. Shared by Jewish, Muslim and Christian communities from Morocco to the Levant.

charms.name: Nimbu-mirchi
charms.description: A lemon and green chillies strung together and hung at shop doors and on vehicles across India to ward off the evil eye, and to give bad luck something sour to chew on instead.

charms.name: Ghanta
charms.description: The temple bell of Hindu and Buddhist worship. Its ring is said to clear the mind of the person who strikes it and to announce their arrival to the divine.

charms.name: Drishti bommai
charms.description: A fierce painted face hung outside homes and building sites in Tamil Nadu. Its job is to draw the evil eye onto itself and away from whatever it guards.

charms.name: Pánchángjié
charms.description: The endless knot, tied from a single red cord with no beginning and no end. A symbol of longevity, unity and good fortune, hung at Lunar New Year.

charms.name: Daruma
charms.description: A round, weighted doll modelled on the monk Bodhidharma. You paint one eye while making a wish and the other when it comes true, and it always rights itself when knocked over.

charms.name: Maneki-neko
charms.description: The beckoning cat, raised paw inviting good fortune through the door. A raised right paw is said to bring money; a raised left paw brings customers.

charms.name: Horseshoe
charms.description: Iron shaped by fire, nailed above a door for luck. Hung open end up it holds the luck in; open end down it pours the luck over those who pass beneath.

charms.name: Scarab
charms.description: The dung beetle, sacred to the sun's rebirth each morning as it rolls its ball across the sky. Worn as an amulet in ancient Egypt for protection and renewal.

charms.name: Himmeli
charms.description: A geometric mobile of rye straw hung above the table at midwinter in Finland to bless the coming harvest. The name comes from the Swedish word for sky.

charms.name: Dream Catcher
charms.description: An Ojibwe hoop webbed like a spider's, hung over a sleeping child so the bad dreams catch in the net and the good ones slip through the middle and down the feathers.

charms.name: Bead
charms.description: A plain glass bead, the charm Hangly ships with. Simple, weighty and never out of place.

charms.name: Star
charms.description: Everyone's first lucky charm. The lightest in the set, so it swings the fastest.

charms.name: Heart
charms.description: Worn on the sleeve, or in this case at the top of the screen.

charms.name: Diamond
charms.description: Cut, faceted and indestructible. Heavy enough to hang the rope nearly straight.

charms.name: Camera
charms.description: For photographers and the perpetually nostalgic. The heaviest charm in the box.

charms.name: Spider-Man
charms.description: Hanging head-down from a thread of his own, which is the way he is most often drawn and the only pose in this set that was already a charm before anybody hung it. Pair him with Spider Thread.

charms.name: Spider-Man Swinging
charms.description: Caught mid-swing on a line he shot a moment ago, one arm up and the rest of him still travelling. The second of him in this set, and the one that looks like it is going somewhere.

charms.name: Captain America Shield
charms.description: Concentric rings and a white star, struck face on. The heaviest thing in the set after the hammer, and it hangs like it.

charms.name: Iron Man Helmet
charms.description: Red and gold plate with the eye slits lit. Faces forward, so it reads as a mask rather than as a head.

charms.name: Thor Hammer
charms.description: Mjölnir, head square on, a rune lit on its face. The heaviest charm in the app, and on a chain it barely moves.

charms.name: Hulk Fist
charms.description: A closed green fist inside a ring. Solid, and the dullest-sounding charm here — nothing about it rings.

charms.name: Batman Symbol
charms.description: Wings spread wide and brushed steel-dark. The widest charm in the app, which is why it hangs at a smaller size than the rest of its set.

charms.name: Superman Shield
charms.description: The crest, cut as a shield and set in silver. Red on chrome, and it catches the light from the same corner every other charm does.

charms.name: Wonder Woman Emblem
charms.description: Gold wings folded into a W, over red and blue. Broad across the shoulders and narrow at the point, so it settles nose-down.

charms.name: Shazam Lightning
charms.description: A single bolt in red and gold. The lightest charm in the set and the quickest to swing.

charms.name: Green Lantern Ring
charms.description: A lit green stone in a silver ring. The one charm in this set that glows rather than shines.

charms.name: Vel
charms.description: Murugan's spear, and the sign of the god himself rather than a weapon he carries. A vel is planted at his hill shrines and carried by pilgrims at Thaipusam; the leaf-shaped blade is read as wisdom, broad at the base and sharp at the point.

charms.name: Vinayagar Coin
charms.description: Vinayagar — Ganesha — struck in relief inside a wreath. He is asked first, before any journey, any examination and any new venture, because he is the one who removes what is in the way.

charms.name: OM Symbol
charms.description: The Om, set in gold and stoned in red and green. It opens a prayer and closes one, and is cut above doorways so that the sound is there whether or not anyone is saying it.

charms.name: Karuppu Statue
charms.description: Karuppasamy, a guardian deity of the village boundary, cast dark and standing with his aruval raised. He is set at the edge of a settlement facing outward: the one who keeps watch on what a house cannot see.

charms.name: Temple Bell
charms.description: The mani, rung on the way in and not on the way out. The note is meant to clear the mind of whatever it walked in carrying, so that what happens next is the only thing in it.

charms.name: RM
charms.description: Namjoon — RM, the leader, and the one who speaks for the seven when there is speaking to be done.

charms.name: Jin
charms.description: Seokjin — Jin, the eldest, and by his own long-running claim worldwide handsome.

charms.name: SUGA
charms.description: Yoongi — SUGA, who produces as Agust D and says the least of the seven on stage.

charms.name: j-hope
charms.description: Hoseok — j-hope, the dancer of the group, and the one the others call their sunshine.

charms.name: Jimin
charms.description: Jimin — the smallest of the seven and the one trained in contemporary dance before any of this.

charms.name: V
charms.description: Taehyung — V, the baritone, and the one who named himself after a letter.

charms.name: Jungkook
charms.description: Jungkook — the maknae, the youngest, and the one who joined at fifteen.

charms.name: Ronaldo 7
charms.description: Portugal's number seven, in the maroon and gold of the home shirt. The seven is the only number in this set that has become a name.

charms.name: Messi 10
charms.description: Argentina's sky blue and white stripes with the ten on the back — the shirt a World Cup was finally won in.

charms.name: Neymar 10
charms.description: Brazil's canarinho yellow, green at the collar and cuffs, ten on the back.

charms.name: Real Madrid
charms.description: The C, F and M interlocked under a royal crown — granted by Alfonso XIII in 1920, which is where the Real comes from.

charms.name: FC Barcelona
charms.description: Blaugrana: the St George's cross and the Catalan bars above, the blue and claret halves below, a ball at the foot.

charms.name: Billie Eilish
charms.description: Green roots over black, sat down in oversized everything, looking like she would rather not be photographed.

charms.name: XXXTentacion
charms.description: Half-blond dreads and folded arms, sitting the way the album covers had him sit.

charms.name: Michael Jackson
charms.description: Caught mid-lean with the fedora down and one sequinned glove up — the pose that needs no caption anywhere on earth.

charms.name: Taylor Swift
charms.description: Sat on a flight case with an acoustic, which is where the songs start before a stadium gets involved.

charms.name: Juice WRLD
charms.description: 999 across the hoodie — his own number, six-six-six turned over, for taking a bad thing and making something of it.

charms.name: The Weeknd
charms.description: Sequined red jacket over black, arms out and eyes shut, halfway through the note that made the night famous.

charms.name: Rachel Green
charms.description: Coffee in hand, bag on the shoulder — which is how she spent a decent fraction of ten years.

charms.name: Monica Geller
charms.description: Arms folded, all in black, and everything behind her exactly where it ought to be.

charms.name: Ross Geller
charms.description: Holding a dinosaur, because he is a palaeontologist and would like a moment of your time to explain it.

charms.name: Joey Tribbiani
charms.description: Leather jacket, finger up, mouth open. You already know the line.

charms.name: Chandler Bing
charms.description: In the suit, hands in pockets, mid-sarcasm. Could his job BE any harder to describe?

charms.name: Phoebe Buffay
charms.description: Guitar in hand, which means a cat somewhere is about to be sung about at length.

charms.name: Walter White
charms.description: Yellow hazmat, a flask of blue in one hand and the gas mask in the other. Still telling himself it is about the family.

charms.name: Jesse Pinkman
charms.description: Beanie and a yellow jacket, standing like a man who has just been told off and is about to be told off again.

charms.name: Saul Goodman
charms.description: Pinstripes, a loud tie and a sign carrying his own catchphrase, which is the most honest thing about him.

charms.name: Gus Fring
charms.description: The good suit, the glasses, and absolutely nothing showing on his face. That is the frightening part.

charms.name: Mike Ehrmantraut
charms.description: Leather jacket, hands where you can see them, and a patience you would be unwise to test.

charms.name: Heisenberg
charms.description: The porkpie hat, the glasses, a bag in one hand and the product in the other. The same man as the hazmat, further along.

charms.name: RV
charms.description: The Fleetwood Bounder, sun-bleached and desert-dented, that did the cooking before anybody had a laboratory. The most recognisable vehicle on television.

charms.name: Eleven
charms.description: Pink dress, buzzed hair, one hand out. The nosebleed comes after.

charms.name: Mike Wheeler
charms.description: Walkie-talkie up, waiting on a reply from someone who may not be able to answer.

charms.name: Dustin Henderson
charms.description: Cap on, headset on, halfway through a sentence and not slowing down for anybody.

charms.name: Lucas Sinclair
charms.description: Camo bandana and a wrist-rocket, drawn and aimed. The only one of them who came prepared.

charms.name: Will Byers
charms.description: Holding the string of Christmas lights his mother nailed to the wall to spell things out, letter by letter.

charms.name: Demogorgon
charms.description: The face opens into five petals. That is the whole of what anybody needs to know about it.

charms.name: Spider-Man and Gwen
charms.description: Spider-Man holds the line with Gwen Stacy hanging below him: the rope is drawn into the charm, so it hangs from his grip.

charms.name: Eye of Agamotto
charms.description: Doctor Strange's amulet: carved bronze bands closed over a green stone that glows from inside.

charms.name: Stormbreaker
charms.description: Thor's axe, rune-cut and bound in leather. The head is heavy, so it hangs blade-down and turns slowly.

charms.name: Doctor Doom
charms.description: Green hood, iron mask, plate armour. The monarch of Latveria, standing as though the room belongs to him.

charms.name: Deadpool and Wolverine
charms.description: Best friends, mid-fight, inside a heart. Five small charms dangle beneath it, from the mask to the claws.

charms.name: Monkey D. Luffy
charms.description: Straw hat, open shirt, fist already on its way. The captain of the Straw Hat Pirates.

charms.name: Roronoa Zoro
charms.description: Three swords, one of them in his teeth. The crew's swordsman, low and ready.

charms.name: Nami
charms.description: The navigator, with her weather staff over her shoulder and a map of the world in her head.

charms.name: Usopp
charms.description: Slingshot drawn, grin wider than his courage. The sniper who tells the best stories on the ship.

charms.name: Sanji
charms.description: Black suit, one leg up and on fire. The cook fights with his feet so his hands stay fit for the kitchen.

charms.name: Tony Tony Chopper
charms.description: The ship's doctor: a reindeer in a blue hat with a white cross, small enough to hang anywhere.

charms.name: Nico Robin
charms.description: The archaeologist, arms crossed and more hands blooming around her than anyone could count.

charms.name: Portgas D. Ace
charms.description: Orange hat, bead necklace, fire running up both arms. Fire Fist, Luffy's older brother.

charms.name: Harry Potter
charms.description: Round glasses, Gryffindor robes, wand out. The boy who lived.

charms.name: Hermione Granger
charms.description: Books under one arm and a wand in the other hand, which is roughly how she arrived at Hogwarts.

charms.name: Ron Weasley
charms.description: Hand-me-down robes and an owl on his shoulder. Harry's best friend, and the bravest about chess.

charms.name: Albus Dumbledore
charms.description: Long beard, embroidered robes, a staff taller than he is. The headmaster of Hogwarts.

charms.name: Lord Voldemort
charms.description: Black robes and dark smoke coiling around him. He Who Must Not Be Named.

charms.name: Hedwig
charms.description: A snowy owl on a branch, yellow-eyed and patient. She delivered every letter that mattered.

charms.name: Golden Snitch
charms.description: A walnut-sized gold ball with silver-veined wings. Catch it and the match is over.

charms.name: Deathly Hallows
charms.description: The cloak, the stone and the wand: a triangle, a circle and a line, cut in polished steel.

charms.name: Ben Tennyson
charms.description: Ten years old, fists up, the Omnitrix already on his wrist.

charms.name: Four Arms
charms.description: A Tetramand: red, enormous, and flexing all four arms at once.

charms.name: Heatblast
charms.description: A Pyronite made of living rock and flame, burning at the hands and feet.

charms.name: XLR8
charms.description: A Kineceleran, blue and black, built for speed with a tail for balance.

charms.name: Diamondhead
charms.description: A Petrosapien grown from green crystal, every edge sharp enough to cut.

charms.name: Cannonbolt
charms.description: An Arburian Pelarota, armoured in yellow plates so he can curl up and roll.

charms.name: Upgrade
charms.description: A Galvanic Mechamorph: black, liquid metal traced with green circuitry.

charms.name: Wildmutt
charms.description: A Vulpimancer: orange fur, claws, and a snarl that does the talking.

charms.name: Omnitrix
charms.description: The watch itself: a green hourglass under glass in a steel dial.

charms.name: Eren Yeager
charms.description: Green cloak flying, blades drawn, gear firing. The boy who swore to wipe out every Titan.

charms.name: Mikasa Ackerman
charms.description: Red scarf, both blades out. The strongest soldier of her year, and never far from Eren.

charms.name: Levi Ackerman
charms.description: Humanity's strongest soldier, cloak spread, mid-turn in the air.

charms.name: Armin Arlert
charms.description: Blond, blade raised, already three moves ahead. The Survey Corps' strategist.

charms.name: Colossal Titan
charms.description: Skinless, sixty metres tall, and wrapped in its own steam. The Titan that broke the wall.

charms.name: Attack Titan
charms.description: Long hair, pointed ears, a roar mid-breath. Eren's Titan form.

charms.name: Survey Corps Emblem
charms.description: The Wings of Freedom, blue and white, on an enamel shield.

charms.name: Cadet Corps Emblem
charms.description: Two crossed swords on a green shield, the badge every recruit wears first.

charms.name: Naruto Uzumaki
charms.description: Orange jumpsuit, kunai in hand, headband on. The ninja who never goes back on his word.

charms.name: Sasuke Uchiha
charms.description: Purple rope belt, sword drawn low. The last Uchiha, and Naruto's rival.

charms.name: Kakashi Hatake
charms.description: Mask up, headband tilted, a little orange book open in one hand. Team 7's sensei.

charms.name: Itachi Uchiha
charms.description: The Akatsuki cloak with its red clouds, two fingers raised. Sasuke's older brother.

charms.name: Minato Namikaze
charms.description: The Fourth Hokage in his flame-trimmed white coat, three-pronged kunai in hand.

charms.name: Kurama
charms.description: The Nine-Tailed Fox, every tail curling like a flame.

charms.name: Akatsuki Cloud
charms.description: The red cloud with its white edge, set in silver.

charms.name: Mangekyō Sharingan
charms.description: Itachi's three curved blades, black on red, in a polished silver ring.

charms.name: Max Mayfield
charms.description: Headphones on and the Upside Down reaching for her. Running up that hill.

charms.name: Steve Harrington
charms.description: Sunglasses, perfect hair, and the nail bat. The best babysitter in Hawkins.

charms.name: Jon Snow
charms.description: Fur cloak, Longclaw drawn. The bastard of Winterfell who went to the Wall.

charms.name: Daenerys Targaryen
charms.description: Silver braids and a young dragon in her arms. The Mother of Dragons.

charms.name: Tyrion Lannister
charms.description: A goblet raised and the Hand's pin on his chest. He drinks and he knows things.

charms.name: Night King
charms.description: Ice-blue skin, a crown of horns, an ice spear raised. The leader of the White Walkers.

charms.name: House Stark
charms.description: The direwolf sigil in silver, every hackle cut sharp. Winter is coming.

charms.name: House Targaryen
charms.description: The three-headed red dragon on black. Fire and blood.

charms.name: House Lannister
charms.description: The gold lion rampant on crimson. Hear me roar.

charms.name: Iron Throne
charms.description: A thousand swords melted into a seat. Heavy, sharp, and never comfortable.

charms.name: Rudraksha
charms.description: A rudraksha seed capped in gold filigree. The bead of Shiva's prayer malas.

charms.name: Shiva Lingam
charms.description: Black stone marked with three bands of ash, a cobra rising over it and jasmine at its base.

charms.name: Buddha
charms.description: Seated on a lotus in gold robes, one hand raised in blessing.

charms.name: Hanuman
charms.description: In flight, mace in one hand, the other held out. The devotee of Rama who carried a mountain.

charms.name: Kaaba
charms.description: The black cube draped in the kiswah, its band of gold calligraphy catching the light.

charms.name: Green Dome
charms.description: The green dome and white minaret of the Prophet's Mosque.

charms.name: Crescent and Star
charms.description: A gold crescent filled with green geometric lattice, a small star hanging inside its curve.

charms.name: Allah Pendant
charms.description: The name of God in raised gold calligraphy on deep green enamel.

charms.name: Cross
charms.description: A gold and white enamel cross with a burst of rays behind it and a crystal at every end.

charms.name: Dove of Peace
charms.description: A white dove with gold-edged wings and an olive branch in its beak.

charms.name: Praying Angel
charms.description: A kneeling angel, wings folded, hands together under a gold halo.

charms.name: Sacred Heart
charms.description: A red heart bound in thorns, crowned with flame and a cross, in a burst of gold rays.

charms.name: Air Jordan 1 Chicago
charms.description: Red, white and black, Wings logo on the collar. The colourway that started it.

charms.name: Air Jordan 1 Bred Patent
charms.description: Black and red in mirror-shine patent leather.

charms.name: Air Jordan 4 Fire Red
charms.description: White leather, mesh panels and fire-red wings at the laces.

charms.name: Air Jordan 11 Concord
charms.description: White upper, black patent mudguard, icy translucent sole.

charms.name: Air Jordan 3
charms.description: Tumbled white leather with the elephant print at the toe and heel.

charms.name: Air Jordan 6 Carmine
charms.description: White and carmine red, with the perforated toe and the spoiler at the heel.

charms.name: Air Jordan 5
charms.description: Black leather, mesh side panels and the red shark teeth on the midsole.

charms.name: Off-White Air Jordan 1
charms.description: The Chicago 1 taken apart: exposed foam, a red zip tie and “AIR” printed on the midsole.

charms.name: Pikachu
charms.description: Yellow, round-cheeked and charged, with the lightning-bolt tail.

charms.name: Charmander
charms.description: An orange lizard with a flame at the tip of its tail that never goes out.

charms.name: Squirtle
charms.description: A blue turtle in a polished shell, ready to spray.

charms.name: Bulbasaur
charms.description: Green and spotted, with the bulb on its back still closed.

charms.name: Charizard
charms.description: Wings spread, claws out, tail curled round. Charmander, all grown up.

charms.name: Dragonair
charms.description: A blue serpent with wing-like ears, coiled in a splash of water.

charms.name: Mewtwo
charms.description: Pale violet and poised to strike. The Pokémon made in a laboratory.

charms.name: Umbreon
charms.description: Black, red-eyed, its rings glowing blue. An Eevee that evolved by moonlight.

charms.name: Ash and Pikachu
charms.description: Cap on, Poké Ball out, Pikachu on his shoulder. I choose you.

charms.name: Poké Ball
charms.description: Red over white, with the button in the middle. Gotta catch 'em all.

charms.name: Ronaldo Portugal
charms.description: Back to us in Portugal red, feet planted wide: the stance before the celebration.

charms.name: Ronaldo Bicycle Kick
charms.description: Upside down in white, boot meeting the ball overhead.

charms.name: Ballon d'Or
charms.description: A golden ball on a golden base: the year's best player, in one object.

charms.name: Champions League Trophy
charms.description: Silver, with the handles that give it its nickname: Big Ears.

charms.name: Messi
charms.description: Holding the number ten up to the crowd with both hands: the Barcelona shirt shown off after the winner.
